In this checkout I can't find either of the changes you describe. There's no justfile, and `Makefile` is still there. Its `test-fast` target runs:

```
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

That's the fast-tests command. It skips the integration tests marked `postgres`, which need a real database. You can run it directly whatever the task runner is.

I can't tell you what the `just` recipe is called, because no justfile exists here. If the removal is on another branch or not committed yet, `just --list` will show the recipes. The name is probably `test-fast`, but I'd be guessing.

The stored project memory still says to use `make test-fast` and `make test`. I haven't changed it, since I don't know the new recipe names. Once you confirm them, I'll update it.
